description: A stereo crossfade mixer between two inputs, with voltage control over the blend and a second modulation added on top

params.text: Inverts the sign of both IN1 channels
Inverts the sign of both IN2 channels
Sets the blend, IN1 alone at the left and IN2 alone at the right; a MOD voltage is added to it
Sets the level of the IN2 side of the blend, 0 to 200%; because of a bracketing fault it never reaches the IN1 side
Attenuates IN1 before the blend, 0 to 100%
Attenuates IN2 before the blend, 0 to 100%
Sets how the MOD input is read: unipolar takes 0-10V as the full sweep, bipolar adds 5V first so a signal centred on 0V covers it
Sets how the MOD2 input is read: unipolar takes 0-10V as the full sweep, bipolar adds 5V first so a signal centred on 0V covers it

inputs.text: The left channel of the first signal; the number of channels on this cable sets the number on the left output
The right channel of the first signal; the number of channels on this cable sets the number on the right output
The left channel of the second signal
The right channel of the second signal
Moves the blend away from the MIX knob setting, scaled by the attenuverter beside it
Moves the blend further, scaled by its own attenuverter and added alongside MOD; it has no effect unless MOD also has a cable in it

outputs.text: The left channel of the blend
The right channel of the blend

notes: a blend value that would go below zero is turned back positive instead of being held at zero, so a MOD swing past the left end folds back towards IN2.
menu: Polyphonic OUTs — carries the input polyphony through to the outputs; with it off every channel is summed into a single-channel output
